articles.description: — David Mager led Pepperdine past West Coast Baptist on Friday with 27 points off of the bench and Anto Balian added 11 points, 13 assists and seven rebounds in a 140-54 victory.

articles.headline: Reserves Brown, Copeland send Seton Hall past NC State in Baha Mar Championship, 87-81 in OT
articles.description: — Backup Rodney Brown Jr. scored 24 points and fellow reserve Terry Copeland Jr. added 22 points and Seton Hall beat NC State 87-81 in overtime in the Baha Mar Championship game on Friday night.

articles.headline: South Dakota transfer Cameron Fens makes UNC debut in 88-72 win over Marshall
articles.description: Cameron Fens, a 7-foot South Dakota transfer who filed a lawsuit seeking to recover a year cut short by a misdiagnosed foot injury, and was granted a temporary restraining order, made his North Carolina debut, scoring nine points in a win over Marshall.

articles.headline: Jason Crowe Jr. and Bryson Tiller score 18 apiece for Missouri in 91-64 win over Le Moyne
articles.description: — Jason Crowe Jr. and Bryson Tiller scored 18 points apiece to lead five Missouri players in double figures and the Tigers beat Le Moyne 91-64 on Friday night for their fourth consecutive win.
